ASUS did not cut corners with the hardware. The screen is great, the keyboard, speakers, microphone, and camera are all very good. For the price of the laptop, the CPU and RAM are very impressive. 

The real centerpiece of this laptop is the OLED screen. It looks great! It's big, bright, clear, and has a nice refresh rate. I expected the screen to be a drain on the battery life. That didn't turn out to be an issue. In my experience, the battery lasted 8 hours while watching movies, browsing the internet, etc. The laptop comes with dimming software pre-installed. The software allows users to dim the screen below normal so it becomes very very very dim. This is wonderful for viewing in a dark room.

Unfortunately, the laptop is not upgradable. There are no free M.2 slots for additional SSDs. There are no empty RAM slots. Technically, you could swap out the 1TB SSD for a larger SSD and swap the 16GB RAM sticks for 32GB sticks, but there are no expansion ports.

The laptop came with some ASUS software and antivirus malware pre-installed. The ASUS software helps keep drivers updated and manage things like the screen setting and keyboard backlight. Annoyingly, in order to use ASUS's software, users have to register an account.

While researching this laptop, I found a lot of misinformation. Some reviewers claimed the keyboard's backlight was not adjustable. In fact, the keyboard's backlight is adjustable in numerous ways. There are dimming keys you can press to increase the brightness, decrease the brightness, or turn-off the backlight altogether. There's also software preinstalled that allows users to change the color or set a theme. Theme's include rainbow color changes, breathing pulse effects, etc. Another thing I heard reviewers complain about was this computer's fans. Some people claimed it was noisy, with constantly throttling fan sounds. I have not experienced fan issues at all. In fact my experience has been just the opposite. The laptop has consistently remained cool and silent during use.

One thing that I found to be slightly irritating was the over-sized touchpad. It's off-center, which makes using it somewhat unintuitive. It's nice and smooth and responsive with great multi-touch functionality. However the size and location make it easy to accidentally right-click when you intend to left-click, etc. It's not a big deal, but it's worth mentioning. 

This laptop has on-board graphics. Personally, I was worried about the lack of a designated GPU. I thought maybe this would lead to poor performance or stuttering. That absolutely has not been an issue for me. In fact that laptop is very smooth and snappy. That being said, it's definitely not designed for intensely demanding tasks like video processing or AI media generation. Since I'm not doing those things and I'm not playing brand new games with staggering hardware demands, I have not had any problems with the display. In fact, not having a GPU has been a huge benefit because the laptop's battery lasts much longer and it generates significantly less heat without a GPU.

Final thoughts: I would absolutely recommend this laptop. It gives a great value, offering excellent hardware for a reasonable price. While researching a laptop, no matter the specs, you never really know about the quality of the product until you feel it in your hand. I can confirm that this feels like a high quality product. I'm very pleased with my purchase.", "This is a solid machine from a technical standpoint, does everything that i need it to do. I still compare it to other laptops that I could have considered and all in all, this one is much preferred."]
